//go:build browser

// The topbar app's phone walk, copied in by rastrillo's
// internal/scaffoldcheck: the home page's way up reaches the Menu page
// at the home row, and that row leads home again.
package walktopbarapp_test

import (
	"io"
	"log/slog"
	"net/http"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"amadan.net/rastrillo/rastrillo/db"
	"amadan.net/rastrillo/rastrillo/harness"
	"github.com/chromedp/chromedp"

	"walktopbarapp/internal/walktopbarapp"
)

// The Menu page is the bar's index view; the home page is a content
// page, whose nav is hidden on a phone and whose up link shows.
const (
	menuRows = `[rst-shell-topbar="index"] [rst-shell-nav] #nav-home`
	upLink   = `[rst-shell-topbar="page"] [rst-shell-up]`
)

func TestPhoneWalksToTheMenuAndBack(t *testing.T) {
	rig := harness.New(t, func(origin string) http.Handler {
		logger := slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(io.Discard, nil))
		path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "app.db")
		database, err := db.Open(path, logger)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("db.Open: %v", err)
		}
		t.Cleanup(func() { database.Close() })
		mux, _, err := walktopbarapp.New(database, origin, logger)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("New: %v", err)
		}
		return mux
	}, harness.WithCoarsePointer())
	rig.Run(chromedp.EmulateViewport(390, 844),
		chromedp.Navigate(rig.Origin+"/"))
	rig.Screen(upLink, "the home page on a phone")
	settle(t, rig, `document.readyState === "complete"`)
	rig.Run(chromedp.Click(chromedp.CSS(upLink)))
	settle(t, rig, `location.pathname === "/menu" && `+
		`location.hash === "#nav-home" && !document.activeViewTransition`)
	rig.Screen(menuRows, "the Menu page, its rows the bar's nav")
	rig.Run(chromedp.Click(chromedp.CSS(menuRows)))
	settle(t, rig, `location.pathname === "/" && `+
		`!document.activeViewTransition`)
	rig.Screen(upLink, "the home page again")
}
